summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong monthly return on movements in authorized and issued share capital for July 2026. The return shows no change in authorized or issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares, with a minor remark about option exercises settled by existing shares held by a trustee. No special-situation event—such as acquisition, tender, restructuring, or capital return—is involved. This is a routine securities movement report required by the Hong Kong exchange and filed with the SEC as a foreign private issuer. No deal terms apply; the filing is administrative compliance.
